# GraphicsHeight

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
GraphicsHeight:Int32
```

## Parameters

**Returns:** The height in pixels.

## Description

The height of the graphics window in pixels, as given to [Graphics](Graphics).
